# Codex capture fixtures

Hook payloads are written from the hook input schemas of Codex CLI 0.167.1
(`codex-rs/hooks/schema/generated`). `tool_input` and `tool_response` have no schema there, so
their values are placeholders. `rollout.jsonl` has the record shapes of a session file that
version wrote, with every value replaced. Nothing here was copied from a real session.
